boundary: Rebuild v1: shared linear CN(alpha,delta) and Cm(alpha,delta) with raw fin force and moment channels; PN and raw acceleration PID retained, launch-capture handover and replay-derived R-77 terms disabled. Nominal normalized gains are transparent shared hypotheses, not datamine coefficients: alpha_force_gain=2 represents equal unit body/fixed-surface and tail alpha-force contributions, while alpha_moment_gain=-1 represents tail-only restoring moment with zero body moment; delta_force_gain=-1 and delta_moment_gain=1 are the matching fin-control hypotheses. Force uses initial-mass reference with q/q_base; I=mL^2/12; unprovided rate and alpha-dot terms are zero hypotheses only. Loft fields are read per missile from the local raw blkx; loftTargetElevation is preserved but unresolved because the current first-order loft command does not consume it.
